title: ΔfH from enthalpies of combustion
caption: Methane cannot be made directly from carbon and hydrogen, but both it and its elements burn to CO₂ and H₂O. ΔfH(CH₄) = [ΔcH(C) + 2ΔcH(H₂)] − ΔcH(CH₄) = (−394 − 572) − (−890) = −76 kJ mol⁻¹ with these rounded values (data books: −75).
alt: A Hess triangle: elements C + 2H₂ top left, CH₄ top right, CO₂ + 2H₂O at the bottom; arrows down from each top corner.
description: Top right: CH₄(g); the arrow between them is ΔfH, unknown.
Down from the elements: −394 + 2 × (−286) = −966 kJ mol⁻¹.
